# braintrust_user (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Braintrust user by email address. This is useful for referencing users when managing group membership or ACLs.

```hcl
data "braintrust_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@company.com"
}

resource "braintrust_group" "team" {
  name         = "My Team"
  member_users = [data.braintrust_user.alice.id]
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) The user's email address. Provide either `email` or `id`.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the user (UUID). Provide either `id` or `email`.

### Read-Only

- `avatar_url` (String) URL of the user's avatar image.
- `created` (String) Date of user creation.
- `family_name` (String) Family (last) name of the user.
- `given_name` (String) Given (first) name of the user.
